title: electrodialysisStack operation
description: Electrodialysis stack: N cell pairs of alternating cation/anion-exchange membranes moving salt from the diluate to the concentrate under a DC current. Give `current` to impose the amperage, or `targetDemin` to ask for a demineralisation fraction and let the current be solved. The run checks the applied current against the LIMITING current from the film model and announces the margin — above i_lim the diluate boundary layer is ion-depleted and water splitting takes over, which is a regime, not a bigger number. The DC power (P = U·I) is published on an energy wire as W_electric, mirroring the shaft-wire convention, so a rectifier (`electricLoad`) absorbs it.

channelLength.title: Flow-path length
channelLength.description: Used by the Leveque film correlation; defaults to 0.5 m.

current.title: Applied current
current.description: Imposed-current form. Raw SI (amperes). Give this OR targetDemin.

targetDemin.title: Target demineralisation
targetDemin.description: Solved-current form: fraction of the diluate's salt to remove; the current is the result.

xi.title: Current efficiency
xi.description: Fraction of the charge that moves salt; defaults to 0.9, announced.

E_electrodes.title: Electrode overpotential
E_electrodes.description: Lumped electrode + electrode-rinse voltage, added to the stack voltage; raw SI (volts), announced.

membrane.title: Ion-exchange membrane pair
membrane.description: Resolved by name (kind IEM), e.g. CMX_AMX; supplies the area resistances and counter-ion transport numbers.
